commits.subject: Keep Tab inside the open overlay when the browser lacks inert
Let buttons and arrow keys turn pages in a very short window

verification.command_or_steps: cd web && npx vitest run src/book.test.ts (tests added; nextTrapIndex stubbed as `=> index`)
verification.notes: 3 of 4 nextTrapIndex tests failed with AssertionError (e.g. 'expected -1 to be +0' for index -1 forward); single-element case passed by coincidence of the stub. 18 other tests passed. No syntax/environment errors.

verification.command_or_steps: cd web && npx vitest run src/book.test.ts

preview 1440x900, `delete HTMLElement.prototype.inert`, open TOC, remove [inert], 18x Tab then 18x Shift+Tab via Playwright keyboard; then Esc; open zoom, remove [inert], Tab/Shift+Tab x5, ArrowRight, Esc; ArrowRight/ArrowLeft after close; then real reload (inert native) + TOC + 16x Tab recording event.defaultPrevented
verification.notes: TOC: focus cycled through all 15 links both directions incl. wrap (13장 -> 표지, 표지 -> 13장 backward), never left .overlay. Zoom: focus stayed on '✕ 닫기' for every press. ArrowRight ignored while zoom open. Esc closed each overlay and focus returned to '목차 열기' / '크게 보기'. After close ArrowRight 45->46, ArrowLeft 46->44 (spread). With native inert: defaultPrevented false on all 16 Tabs, i.e. the new branch did not run (one Tab went to browser chrome, normal native behaviour).

verification.notes: Book box 56.5x39.98. ▶ and ArrowRight: stayed on 45 (no turn). ◀ and ArrowLeft did turn (45->42->40), so at this size only the forward direction was blocked in Chromium.

verification.command_or_steps: preview at 1440x160, 1440x900, 390x844 from #/p/45: ▶, ArrowRight, ◀, ArrowLeft, click in centre of visible (right-hand) page; corner hover then leave; bottom-right and bottom-left corner clicks
verification.notes: 1440x160 (spread): 45->46->48->46->44, centre click stays 44. 1440x900 (spread): same sequence, centre click stays. 390x844 (single): 45->46->47->46->45, centre click stays. Corner clicks turn forward/back at all three sizes. Hover fold shown at all sizes; at 1440x900 and 390x844 leaving the hover does not turn the page.
